mechanism: TURN-CADENCE DEFICIT, measured: our floor spends 6.4k-9.6k tokens per acting turn vs the reference config's ~1.0-1.3k - 7x the deliberation per action - yielding 7-15 acting turns/game vs their 45-50; we die clock-killed at 55/7/62 actions vs their 120-300. Extreme datum: r11l generated 41,513 tokens between actions 6 and 7. When our agent DOES act it is MORE action-efficient than the reference (r11l cleared in 4-12 actions vs their median 14.5). We are not worse at these games; we are barely playing them.
reconciles: 62% no-action generations carrying half the tokens; 88% post-clear burn; and epsilon=0.17 - extra wallclock buys more overthinking (T3 degeneration), while converting deliberation into acting turns is a different axis. The reference run is the existence proof that ~45 acting turns clears these levels.
corrections: GRINDER label on bp35/sp80 at L1 WRONG - both were TRUNCATED (T3 cleared bp35 in 38 actions, fewer than the floor spent); 'lost to draw noise' imprecise - systematic cadence deficit; honest deflation: conditioned on our action counts the reference's own P(0/0/0) ~= 0.24, so 65%-vs-0 was never as stark as it looked. The mechanism is real regardless and bigger than three games.
consequence: Monday slot 1 = turn-cadence arm (deliberation cap, a SUBTRACTION, budget-positive; primary instruments tokens-per-acting-turn + acting-turns-per-game, lc as outcome; the more-turns-no-lc branch is a decisive family kill). Weekend: price K-token cap vs medium-effort pin (medium-on-current-floor is UNTESTED - the Q38 medium REFUTE was June-30-harness only) as two routes to one axis.
lesson: MEASURE TOKENS-PER-ACTION, NOT TOKENS-PER-TURN: an agent can be efficient per action and still never play. A capability judgment made without a cadence instrument attributes clock starvation to skill.
why_informative: The campaign's strongest mechanism finding: it locates the per-turn-value program's target precisely (deliberation-to-action conversion), supplies an existence proof from the field's own reference run, and was obtained for zero GPU from artifacts nobody had read. It also retro-explains the elasticity curve's saturation.
